title_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Tek Mara Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Perfekte !!
description_sq: Ne Don Bosko, Tek Mara Rezidence, Shitet Apartament 2+1+2, Me Planimetri Perfekte !! Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 112.5 m2, ndodhet ne katin e 8-te te nje pallati 9-katesh me ashensor. Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne dhomen e ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me garderobe dhe tualet me vete, ballkoni dhe tualeti dites. Pallati ne te cilin ndodhet apartamenti dallohet per punimet cilesore, duke filluar nga instalimet hidraulike inkaso, instalimet e sistemit te kondicionimit multisplit, shtrimi me parket ose me pllake, dritare dopioxham termike etj. Ndertimi aktualisht ndodhet ne faze tulle dhe perfundon per nje afat 1 vit e gjysme.
title_en: In Don Bosco, at Mara Residence, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan!!
description_en: In Don Bosco, at Mara Residence, 2+1+2 apartment for sale, with perfect floor plan!! The apartment with a total area of ​​112.5 m2 is located on the 8th floor of a 9-story building with an elevator. The apartment is organized in a living room with a kitchenette, a double bedroom with a wardrobe and a separate toilet, a balcony and a day toilet. The building in which the apartment is located stands out for its quality works, starting from inkaso plumbing installations, multisplit air conditioning system installations, flooring with parquet or tiles, thermal double-glazed windows, etc. The building is currently in the brick phase and will be completed for a period of 1 year and a half.
